name: Dewford Old Rod: talking to the fisherman asks the question and advances nothing

expect.text:
This is a renowned fishing spot.
Are you getting the itch to fish?

name: Dewford Old Rod: yes gives the Old Rod, advances the stage and then gives the fishing advice

expect.text:
And, as an added bonus, I’ll even throw
in a little fishing advice!\pFirst, you want to face the water,
then use the ROD.\pFocus your mind…
If you get a bite, pull on the ROD.\pSometimes you can snag something
immediately, but with bigger catches,\lyou need to time the pulls on your ROD\lto haul them in.

name: Dewford Old Rod: no says that is too bad and leaves the stage alone

expect.text:
Oh, is that so?
That’s too bad, then.

name: Dewford Old Rod: once received, the fisherman asks how the fishing is going and a good answer gets a cheer

expect.text:
Is that right! That’s great!
Haul in some big ones!

name: Dewford Old Rod: once received, a bad answer to the fishing question gets fishing advice

expect.text:
Oh, hey, don’t get down on yourself!
I’ll give you a little fishing advice.\pFirst, you want to face the water,
then use the ROD.\pFocus your mind…
If you get a bite, pull the ROD.\pSometimes you can snag something
immediately, but with bigger catches,\lyou need to time the pulls on your ROD\lto haul them in.
